classes.name: AttendanceReportData
classes.description: Implements ReportData interface for attendance report data retrieval and metadata generation, leveraging various traits for attendance services, internationalization, and number formatting.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Fetches attendance records, processes each record to include employee names and total hours, handling past employees, and returns the data array.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Generates metadata for the report, including total attendance duration and count, packaged within a ParameterBag object.
